items.title: Too Little Time
items.text: Proud to be the 3,590th backer on Gamefound for Too Little Time.
items.detail: Backed the time-traveling boss battler from Chip Theory Games, set in the world of Too Many Bones. Explore Daelore's past, present, and future, with actions that carry over into subsequent plays.

items.title: Lorenzo il Magnifico - A New Renaissance
items.text: Proud to be the 1,552nd backer on Gamefound for Lorenzo il Magnifico - A New Renaissance.
items.detail: Backed the 10th anniversary campaign from Cranio Creations, celebrating Lorenzo il Magnifico with the Prima Lux and Maiestas editions, refreshed artwork, and deluxe upgrades.

items.title: Arkham Horror Remastered - Vault Series
items.text: Proud to be the 1,078th backer on Gamefound for Arkham Horror Remastered - Vault Series.
items.detail: Backed the first Vault Series campaign from Fantasy Flight Games, bringing back the classic 2005 Arkham Horror board game with new artwork, upgraded components, and clarified rules.

items.title: The Danes - A Feast for Odin game
items.text: Proud to be the 4,971st backer on Gamefound for The Danes - A Feast for Odin game.
items.detail: Backed the new A Feast for Odin game from Feuerland, designed by Gernot Köpke and Uwe Rosenberg.

items.title: Arkham Horror: The Card Game — Traces to Nowhere Scenario Pack
items.text: Traces to Nowhere is now available for Arkham Horror: The Card Game, sending investigators into a new mystery of disappearances across Arkham.
items.detail: Question suspects and evade the Abductor in a replayable scenario that changes with the culprit. Play it on its own or as a campaign side-story; an Arkham Horror: The Card Game core set is required.

items.title: Clank! — Cube of Holding and The Forgotten Vault
items.text: Proud to be the 7,700th backer on Kickstarter for Clank! — Cube of Holding and The Forgotten Vault.
items.detail: Backed the Clank! 10th anniversary campaign from Dire Wolf, featuring the Cube of Holding deluxe storage box with 33 premium miniatures, The Forgotten Vault expansion, and upgraded Master Thief Editions.

items.title: Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game - Factory, Bulwark & Forge Expansions
items.text: Proud to be the 2,755th backer on Gamefound for Heroes of Might and Magic III: The Board Game - Factory, Bulwark & Forge Expansions.
items.detail: Backed the latest Heroes III board game campaign from Archon Studio, featuring the Factory, Bulwark, and Forge expansions.

items.title: Ark Nova World Championship — Coming in 2027
items.text: Four qualifying champions will be invited to Berlin in summer 2027 to compete for the ultimate Ark Nova championship.
items.detail: Tickets will go to the 2026 Ark Nova Ring Winner at WSBG Las Vegas, the Ark Nova Digital Champion, and the top players from the Western and Eastern Hemispheres in Board Game Arena Season 27. Each qualifier receives a flight to Berlin and hotel accommodation for the championship.

items.title: Parks Europe - Chalet Edition + Free Expansion
items.text: Proud to be the 4,894th backer on BackerKit for Parks Europe - Chalet Edition + Free Expansion.
items.detail: The deluxe Chalet Edition campaign from Keymaster includes upgraded PARKS Europe components, 48 real European national parks, and the World Heritage Sites Mini Expansion free for backers.

items.title: Steamforged Games — Layoffs and Crowdfunding Concerns
items.text: BoardGameWire first reported Steamforged's confirmed layoffs and crowdfunding cutback on June 4. Sources estimated that around a third of staff were affected as the publisher shifted its focus to Warmachine; the company did not confirm the scale of the cuts.
items.detail: An October 9 follow-up reported dwindling updates and unresolved refund requests across nine campaigns that raised £18.83 million and still had outstanding fulfilment. Some deliveries were overdue, while others were not yet due. The reports do not establish bankruptcy; September's compulsory strike-off proceedings were discontinued. Steamforged said it retained the resources needed to deliver its commitments.

items.title: Children of Blood — Arkham Horror Campaign Expansion
items.text: One to four investigators face a vampiric mystery across three scenarios in this small campaign expansion for Arkham Horror: The Card Game.
items.detail: Track monsters through Arkham's streets, explore the caverns below, and infiltrate a Northside party. New blood tokens threaten to transform the investigators, while difficulty-dependent locations and encounters offer new challenges on repeat plays. Requires the Arkham Horror: The Card Game core set.

items.title: Arkham Horror: The Card Game — Chapter Two Core Set
items.text: Chapter Two begins with a new core set, five mechanically new investigators, and the three-scenario Brethren of Ash campaign.
items.detail: Set in Arkham after a devastating calamity, the new core set offers a fresh starting point for new players and a new card pool for veterans. It replaces the 2021 Revised Core Set, while all player content remains compatible with previously released Arkham Horror: The Card Game products.
